name: Paladin Judge
body:
A judge is a paladin called upon to be a holy truthseeker and adjutant.

Bureaucratic Knowledge (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, a judge gains a bonus on skill checks related to recalling, knowing, or employing local laws. For example, this could grant a bonus to a Knowledge check to recall local laws, then Diplomacy to relate them in a court of law. This also gives you a bonus to skill checks to know if a creature is a criminal or has a bounty upon it.

This ability replaces detect evil.

Smite the Criminal (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, once per day, a judge can call down divine power against a criminal. This functions as smite evil, except it does not target evil creatures. Instead it functions against creatures you know are criminals or have a bounty. For prerequisite and feat purposes, this is considered to be smite evil.

This ability modifies smite evil.

Aura of Justice (Su)

At 11th level, a judge’s aura of justice grants all allies the use of their smite the criminal instead of smite evil.

This ability modifies aura of justice.
